newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE March white sugar closes back over support.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE March white sugar closes back over support.

text.p: London's March white sugar contract dipped briefly below $300 late on Friday afternoon but steady buying ensured that the psychological support level remained relatively intact, traders said.
All contracts were trapped in tight ranges of around $2 and the two nearby spreads stayed mostly flat throughout the day.

Early commission house selling of March/May kept the spot value under pressure but the weakness was countered by mixed light buying and also the slight firmness in the New York market. The white premium was reasonably steady at around $67.
By the close March was down $1.00 cents at $300.60 and May down $1.40 cents at $299.70. Volume on March amounted to 1,196 lots and May 560 lots, boosted by AAs.

Results have yet to emerge from Libya's buying tender and European sugar traders said it was still unclear whether anything had been bought at all or if Libya had passed on the offers received or postponed the tender.
Paris futures were slightly lower in thin trade.
March was down $1.00 at $300.50 and May down 70 cents also at $300.50.
